Transcript

  1. You know this story. Weeks of late nights, poured into one project!
  2. An app! A report! A pitch deck! And then? Nothing.
  3. They take it to meetings. Long pages! Endless slides! Diagrams! And everyone tunes out.
  4. Great films take great crews! Every job, a specialist. Real craft. But small projects rarely get one.
  5. What if your project made its own trailer? One prompt starts it! The script! The scenes! The voice! The music! And out comes your film!
  6. Step one. Your project files go in. Code! Documents! Slides! Spreadsheets! An AI assistant reads them, and drafts your script.
  7. Step two. Your story, alive in three D! Streets! People! Motion! Any angle! All of it, just code!
  8. Step three. An AI voice tells it. Choose a voice! Choose a language! Timed to every scene. Change a word? It is spoken again.
  9. Step four. A backing track, made in code. Chords! Drums! Bass! Melody! No song copied. No artist imitated. Real songs need real musicians!
  10. Step five. One single page. Laptop! Phone! Big screen! Or export an MP4, and share it!
  11. And now? They stop. They watch. The same people. The same project. Finally seen!
  12. This trailer was made with the prompt and the tools you just saw. Yours could be next!
